name: Growth
strategy: Long-term capital growth with a quality and technology tilt
description: Maximises long-term capital appreciation. ~90% equities, half through broad and growth ETFs, half through 15 high-quality large caps; a small bond sleeve for liquidity.

name: Equity Income
description: Targets a sustainable, growing income stream from dividend payers, covered-call and international dividend funds, with preferreds and credit for extra yield. Client draws a monthly income.

name: Balanced
description: Growth with moderated volatility: 60% equities (half ETFs, half blue chips), 35% investment-grade bonds and TIPS, a small gold hedge.

name: Conservative Income
description: Protects capital and pays income: two-thirds short and intermediate high-quality bonds, a defensive equity sleeve, and a T-bill buffer. Client draws a monthly income.

name: Global Multi-Asset
description: Diversified across global equities (including non-US leaders), inflation-linked and EM bonds, gold, commodities, listed real estate and infrastructure.
